reason: Criterion 3 pre-decided two things the ADR is meant to decide: it named open as a manifest reader and complete as pinning artifacts. Review rounds 4-5 showed open has no reason to read a manifest (effective scope is the gate's, from the base side, so a manifest change between opening and gating changes what the gate enforces and nothing else) and that pinning belongs to an archival finding, not to complete. The criterion now asks for the reader list and its reasons, and leaves pinning to the ADR.
